name: DescribePvtzStatisticsSummary

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The statistics module. Valid values: AUTHORITY, AUTH_FAST, AUTH_SLOW, GLOBAL, CACHE, FORWARD, and RECURSION
parameters.name: module

parameters.example:
- QTYPE_RATIO: Distribution ratio of DNS request record types.
- NEGATIVE_RCODE: Negative DNS response type statistics.
- RCODE_DOMAIN: Top domains by negative response count
- RCODE_SOURCE_IP: Top source IP addresses requesting a specific domain with negative responses.
- REQUEST_ZONE: Domain request volume ranking (zone level).
- REQUEST_DOMAIN: Subdomain request volume ranking (domain name level).
- VPC_RATIO: Request source distribution ratio.
- SOURCE_VPC: Hot source network analysis for requests.
- SOURCE_IP: Request source IP address statistics.
- LINE_RATIO: Traffic distribution ratio by resolution line.
- LINE_HIT: Resolution line hit details.
parameters.help_en: The type of statistics to collect. Valid values: QTYPE_RATIO: The ratio of DNS request record types. NEGATIVE_RCODE: Statistics on negative DNS responses. RCODE_DOMAIN: The top domain names that receive negative responses. RCODE_SOURCE_IP: The top source IP addresses for requests to a specified domain name that receive negative responses. REQUEST_ZONE: The top zones by request volume. REQUEST_DOMAIN: The top subdomains by request volume. VPC_RATIO: The ratio of request sources. SOURCE_VPC: Analysis of high-traffic source networks. SOURCE_IP: Statistics on source IP addresses. LINE_RATIO: The percentage of traffic per resolution line. LINE_HIT: Details about resolution line hits
parameters.name: statistical_type

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: ASC and DESC
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

fields.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VPC
fields.name: vpc_owner

fields.help_en:
The type of the VPC.

STANDARD: A standard VPC.

EDS: A VPC for Elastic Desktop Service (EDS)
fields.help_zh:
vpc类型。

STANDARD：标准VPC。

EDS：无影工作区VPC
fields.name: vpc_type

fields.help_en: The ID of the region where the VPC is deployed
fields.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The time granularity for the statistics
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: Specifies the type of change in request volume to report. Valid values: up (request spikes) and down (request drops)
parameters.help_zh: 请求量突增突降子域名数报表
parameters.name: grow_type

parameters.help_en: The field by which to sort the results. To sort by fluctuation ratio, set this parameter to fluctuation_ratio
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。按照波动率排序：fluctuation_ratio
parameters.name: order_by
